### Interpretations

```{r}
fit   <- bayes_single
train <- fit$data %>% mutate(ui_userN = droplevels(ui_userN))

y_obs <- train$ci_cycleLength
stopifnot(is.numeric(y_obs))
```

#### Covariate Effects

```{r}
#Covariate effects in clinician units (mu in days, sigma in % change)
draws <- posterior::as_draws_df(fit)
```

```{r}
#mean effects: exclude intercept
mu_eff <- draws %>%
  dplyr::select(starts_with("b_"),
         -starts_with("b_sigma_"),
         -b_Intercept) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "term", values_to = "beta") %>%
  mutate(
    panel = "Association with average length (μ, % difference)",  # updated label
    term  = sub("^b_", "", term),
    effect = 100 * (exp(beta) - 1)                            # updated formula
  )

#sigma effects: exclude sigma intercept
sig_eff <- draws %>%
  dplyr::select(starts_with("b_sigma_"),
         -b_sigma_Intercept) %>%  # <-- remove sigma intercept
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "term", values_to = "beta") %>%
  mutate(
    panel = "Association with variability (σ, % difference)",
    term  = sub("^b_sigma_", "", term),
    effect = 100 * (exp(beta) - 1)
  )

# Combine
eff_sum <- bind_rows(mu_eff, sig_eff) %>%
  group_by(panel, term) %>%
  summarise(
    med = median(effect),
    lo = quantile(effect, 0.025),
    hi = quantile(effect, 0.975),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(term = fct_reorder(term, med))

#plot
ggplot(eff_sum, aes(y = label, x = med, xmin = lo, xmax = hi)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_pointrange() +
  facet_wrap(~panel, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

#### Variance Decomposition

```{r}
# Raw variance components from the model
vc <- VarCorr(fit)
 
# ICC for the mean (mu) sub-model
# For a log-normal mixed model the within-woman "residual" variance on the log
# scale is sigma^2 (the dispersion parameter).  The between-woman variance is
# tau^2_mu (random intercept SD squared).
# We compute both from the posterior draws for a proper uncertainty estimate.
 
# Posterior draws for the random-effect SDs
tau_mu    <- draws$`sd_ui_userN__Intercept`          # between-woman SD (mu)
tau_sigma <- draws$`sd_ui_userN__sigma_Intercept`    # between-woman SD (sigma)
 
# Posterior draws for the population-level sigma intercept (log scale)
# exp(b_sigma_Intercept) ≈ median within-woman sigma
sigma_intercept_log <- draws$b_sigma_Intercept
sigma_within        <- exp(sigma_intercept_log)         # median within-woman sigma
 
# ICC for mu:  tau_mu^2 / (tau_mu^2 + sigma_within^2)
# (sigma_within^2 is the average within-woman variance on the log scale)
icc_mu <- (tau_mu^2) / (tau_mu^2 + sigma_within^2)
 
# ICC for sigma (log-scale regularity):
# between-woman sigma-SD^2 / (between + average within residual variance)
# Use pi^2/3 as a reference within-cluster variance on log scale (logistic approx.)
icc_sigma <- (tau_sigma^2) / (tau_sigma^2 + (pi^2 / 3))
```

```{r}
cat("\n========== VARIANCE DECOMPOSITION ==========\n")
cat(sprintf(
  "Between-woman SD (mu, log scale):    %.3f  [95%% CrI: %.3f, %.3f]\n",
  median(tau_mu), quantile(tau_mu, 0.025), quantile(tau_mu, 0.975)
))
cat(sprintf(
  "Median within-woman sigma:           %.3f  [95%% CrI: %.3f, %.3f]\n",
  median(sigma_within), quantile(sigma_within, 0.025), quantile(sigma_within, 0.975)
))
cat(sprintf(
  "ICC (mu)   – %% of log-scale variance between women: %.1f%%  [%.1f%%, %.1f%%]\n",
  100 * median(icc_mu),
  100 * quantile(icc_mu, 0.025),
  100 * quantile(icc_mu, 0.975)
))
cat(sprintf(
  "Between-woman SD (sigma, log scale): %.3f  [95%% CrI: %.3f, %.3f]\n",
  median(tau_sigma), quantile(tau_sigma, 0.025), quantile(tau_sigma, 0.975)
))
cat(sprintf(
  "ICC (sigma) – %% of log-scale sigma variance between women: %.1f%%  [%.1f%%, %.1f%%]\n",
  100 * median(icc_sigma),
  100 * quantile(icc_sigma, 0.025),
  100 * quantile(icc_sigma, 0.975)
))
```

```{r}
## more summary output
# Between-woman SD in days
tau_mu_days <- exp(mean(draws$b_Intercept)) * draws$`sd_ui_userN__Intercept`
median(tau_mu_days)
quantile(tau_mu_days, c(0.025, 0.975))

# One SD above and below in irregularity
sigma_intercept <- draws$b_sigma_Intercept
tau_sigma <- draws$`sd_ui_userN__sigma_Intercept`
mu_intercept <- draws$b_Intercept

# One SD above in irregularity
sd_above <- exp(mu_intercept) * sqrt(exp(exp(sigma_intercept + tau_sigma)^2) - 1)
median(sd_above)

# One SD below in irregularity
sd_below <- exp(mu_intercept) * sqrt(exp(exp(sigma_intercept - tau_sigma)^2) - 1)
median(sd_below)
```


### Data Visualizations

#### Posterior Predictive Check

```{r}
#overall posterior predictive check
set.seed(1)
yrep <- brms::posterior_predict(
  fit,
  newdata = train,
  re_formula = NULL,   # include woman-specific REs
  ndraws = 400
)  # matrix: draws x N
dim(yrep)
```

```{r}
#plot observed vs predicted densities
# Sample a subset of draws for plotting (avoid overplotting)
draw_idx <- sample(seq_len(nrow(yrep)), size = min(50, nrow(yrep)))

yrep_long <- tibble(
  draw = rep(draw_idx, each = ncol(yrep)),
  y = as.vector(yrep[draw_idx, , drop = FALSE])
)

ggplot() +
  geom_density(data = yrep_long, aes(x = y, group = draw), color = "grey", alpha = 0.05) +
  geom_density(aes(x = y_obs), linewidth = 1.2, color = "blue") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(min(y_obs), 60)) +
  labs(
    x = "Cycle length (days)",
    y = "Density",
    title = "Posterior predictive check: distribution of cycle lengths",
    subtitle = "Black = observed; gray = replicated datasets (includes long right tail)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

#### Woman-Level Predictive Intervals

```{r}
#heterogeneity across women
#Woman-level predictive intervals (“forest plot”), show top 60 women
id <- train$ui_userN
ids <- levels(id)

woman_q <- function(u) {
  cols <- which(id == u)
  vals <- as.vector(yrep[, cols, drop = FALSE])
  tibble(
    ui_userN = u,
    med = median(vals),
    lo50 = quantile(vals, 0.25),
    hi50 = quantile(vals, 0.75),
    lo80 = quantile(vals, 0.10),
    hi80 = quantile(vals, 0.90),
    lo95 = quantile(vals, 0.025),
    hi95 = quantile(vals, 0.975)
  )
}

pp_by_woman <- bind_rows(lapply(ids, woman_q)) %>%
  arrange(med) %>%
  mutate(ui_userN_ord = fct_inorder(as.factor(ui_userN)))

pp_plot <- pp_by_woman %>% slice_head(n = 30)

ggplot(pp_plot, aes(y = ui_userN_ord)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = lo95, xend = hi95, yend = ui_userN_ord), linewidth = 0.6, alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = lo80, xend = hi80, yend = ui_userN_ord), linewidth = 1.0, alpha = 0.45) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = lo50, xend = hi50, yend = ui_userN_ord), linewidth = 1.8, alpha = 0.75) +
  geom_point(aes(x = med), size = 1.6) +
  labs(
    x = "Predicted cycle length for a new cycle (days)",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Heterogeneity across women: predicted cycle ranges",
    subtitle = "Each row = woman; bars = 50/80/95% predictive intervals; top 30 shown"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
```

#### Within-Woman Regularity

```{r}
## EXACT LOGNORMAL SD IN DAYS (per woman)
# True SD of a log-normal(mu, sigma) = exp(mu + sigma^2/2) * sqrt(exp(sigma^2) - 1)
# We need woman-level posterior draws for both mu and sigma.
 
dat_women <- train %>%
  group_by(ui_userN) %>%
  summarise(
    n_cycles = n(),
    ci_age_group            = first(ci_age_group),
    ui_ansMenarche_group    = first(ui_ansMenarche_group),
    ui_pcos_impute          = first(ui_pcos_impute),
    ui_endometriosis_impute = first(ui_endometriosis_impute),
    ui_bmi_cat              = first(ui_bmi_cat),
    ui_activitylevel        = first(ui_activitylevel),
    ci_spotting_logged      = FALSE,
    ci_sickness_logged      = FALSE,
    ci_mood_logged          = FALSE,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
 
# Posterior draws: mu (response scale = days) and sigma (log scale)
mu_draws_mat    <- posterior_epred(fit, newdata = dat_women, re_formula = NULL)
sigma_draws_mat <- posterior_linpred(fit, dpar = "sigma", newdata = dat_women,
                                     re_formula = NULL, transform = TRUE)
 
# For each draw, compute true lognormal SD per woman
# then summarize over draws
n_draws <- nrow(mu_draws_mat)
n_women <- ncol(mu_draws_mat)
 
# log-scale mu per woman per draw: log(E[Y]) - sigma^2/2  ≈  log(mu_draws)
# More precisely: log-scale mu = log(mu_epred) - sigma^2/2
log_mu_mat <- log(mu_draws_mat) - (sigma_draws_mat^2) / 2
 
sd_days_mat <- exp(log_mu_mat + sigma_draws_mat^2 / 2) *
               sqrt(exp(sigma_draws_mat^2) - 1)
 
# Woman-level summaries
sd_days_summary <- tibble(
  ui_userN = dat_women$ui_userN,
  sd_med   = apply(sd_days_mat, 2, median),
  sd_lo    = apply(sd_days_mat, 2, function(x) quantile(x, 0.025)),
  sd_hi    = apply(sd_days_mat, 2, function(x) quantile(x, 0.975))
)
 
mean_days_summary <- tibble(
  ui_userN  = dat_women$ui_userN,
  mean_med  = apply(mu_draws_mat, 2, median)
)
```

```{r}
#population level averages
pop_mean_per_draw <- rowMeans(mu_draws_mat)
median(pop_mean_per_draw)
quantile(pop_mean_per_draw, c(0.025, 0.975))
pop_mean <- median(pop_mean_per_draw)  # 29.2 days

pop_sd_per_draw <- rowMeans(sd_days_mat)
median(pop_sd_per_draw)
quantile(pop_sd_per_draw, c(0.025, 0.975))
pop_sd   <- median(pop_sd_per_draw)    # 3.2 days
```

```{r}
#subplots of means and SDs by PCOS, endometriosis, and age groups
char_summary <- mu_sigma_exact %>%
  left_join(
    dat_women,
    by = "ui_userN"
  ) %>%
  mutate(ci_age_group = factor(ci_age_group, levels = c("18-24", "25-29", "30-34", "35-39", "40-45")))

#overlaid density for binary groups
plot_density_binary <- function(data, group_var, group_label) {
  
  med_lines <- data %>%
    group_by({{ group_var }}) %>%
    summarise(
      med_mean = median(mean_med),
      med_sd   = median(sd_med),
      .groups  = "drop"
    )
  
  p_mean <- ggplot(data, aes(x = mean_med, fill = {{ group_var }}, 
                              color = {{ group_var }})) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.35, linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_vline(data = med_lines, 
               aes(xintercept = med_mean, color = {{ group_var }}),
               linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.9) +
    labs(x = "Mean cycle length (days)", y = "Density",
         fill = group_label, color = group_label) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  
  p_sd <- ggplot(data, aes(x = sd_med, fill = {{ group_var }}, 
                            color = {{ group_var }})) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.35, linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_vline(data = med_lines,
               aes(xintercept = med_sd, color = {{ group_var }}),
               linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.9) +
    labs(x = "SD of cycle length (days)", y = "Density",
         fill = group_label, color = group_label) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  
  p_mean | p_sd
}

#ridge plot for multi-level groups
plot_ridge <- function(data, group_var, group_label, xmax) {
  
  p_mean <- ggplot(data, aes(x = mean_med, y = {{ group_var }}, 
                              fill = {{ group_var }})) +
    geom_density_ridges(alpha = 0.7, scale = 0.9,
                        quantile_lines = TRUE, quantiles = 2) +
    labs(x = "Mean cycle length (days)", y = group_label) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
  
  p_sd <- ggplot(data, aes(x = sd_med, y = {{ group_var }}, 
                            fill = {{ group_var }})) +
    geom_density_ridges(alpha = 0.7, scale = 0.9,
                        quantile_lines = TRUE, quantiles = 2) +
    xlim(0, xmax) +
    labs(x = "SD of cycle length (days)", y = group_label) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
  
  p_mean | p_sd
}

#Plots
plot_density_binary(char_summary, ui_pcos_impute,          "PCOS")
plot_density_binary(char_summary, ui_endometriosis_impute, "Endometriosis")
plot_ridge(char_summary,          ci_age_group,            "Age Group", 12)
```


#### Within-Woman Autocorrelation

```{r}
## WITHIN-WOMAN AUTOCORRELATION CHECK
# Compute residuals on the log scale, then check ACF per woman.
# A meaningful positive ACF at lag 1 would suggest the random intercept
# alone doesn't capture within-woman serial dependence.
 
log_resid <- log(train$ci_cycleLength) -
             fitted(fit, scale = "linear")[, "Estimate"]
 
acf_dat <- train %>%
  mutate(log_resid = log_resid) %>%
  group_by(ui_userN) %>%
  filter(n() >= 10) %>%          # only women with enough cycles for ACF
  summarise(
    acf_lag1 = {
      a <- acf(log_resid, lag.max = 1, plot = FALSE)
      a$acf[2]   # lag-1 autocorrelation
    },
    n_cycles = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
 
cat("\n========== WITHIN-WOMAN AUTOCORRELATION CHECK ==========\n")
cat(sprintf("Median lag-1 ACF across women:  %.3f\n", median(acf_dat$acf_lag1)))
cat(sprintf("IQR:                            [%.3f, %.3f]\n",
            quantile(acf_dat$acf_lag1, 0.25),
            quantile(acf_dat$acf_lag1, 0.75)))
cat(sprintf("%% of women with |ACF| > 0.1:   %.1f%%\n",
            100 * mean(abs(acf_dat$acf_lag1) > 0.1)))
cat("  If median ACF is near 0, exchangeability assumption is reasonable.\n")
cat("  If notably positive, consider an AR(1) random effect for future work.\n")
```

```{r}
# Distribution of lag-1 ACF
ggplot(acf_dat, aes(x = acf_lag1)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 60, fill = "#028090", color = "white", alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "#B85042", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title    = "Within-woman lag-1 autocorrelation of log-scale residuals",
    subtitle = sprintf("N = %d women with ≥ 10 cycles; values near 0 support exchangeability",
                       nrow(acf_dat)),
    x        = "Lag-1 autocorrelation",
    y        = "Number of women"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
```

```{r}
# ACF vs. number of cycles
ggplot(acf_dat, aes(x = n_cycles, y = acf_lag1)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = TRUE, color = "#028090") +
  labs(
    title = "Lag-1 ACF vs. number of cycles per woman",
    x     = "Number of cycles",
    y     = "Lag-1 ACF"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
```

#### Scenarios

```{r}
# Define clinical profile grid:
# Reference: Age 25-29 | Menarche 12-13 | No PCOS | Active | No sickness

scenario_dat <- tribble(
  ~scenario_label,                         ~ci_age_group, ~ui_ansMenarche_group, ~ui_pcos_impute, ~ui_activitylevel, ~ci_sickness_logged,
  "Reference: Age 25-29 | Menarche 12–13 | No PCOS |\n Active | No sickness",
                                           "25-29",       "12-13",               0,               "Active",          FALSE,
  "*Age 40-45 | Menarche 12-13 | No PCOS |\n Active | No sickness",
                                           "40-45",       "12-13",               0,               "Active",          FALSE,
  "Age 25-29 | *Menarche ≥14 | No PCOS |\n Active | No sickness",
                                           "25-29",       ">= 14",               0,               "Active",          FALSE,
  "Age 25-29 | Menarche 12-13 | *PCOS |\n Active | No sickness",
                                           "25-29",       "12-13",               1,               "Active",          FALSE,
  "Age 25-29 | Menarche 12-13 | No PCOS |\n *Not active | No sickness",
                                           "25-29",       "12-13",               0,               "Not active",      FALSE,
  "Age 25-29 | Menarche 12-13 | No PCOS |\n Active | *Sickness",
                                           "25-29",       "12-13",               0,               "Active",          TRUE
) %>%
  mutate(
    ui_bmi_cat              = "Healthy Weight",
    ui_endometriosis_impute = 0,
    ci_spotting_logged      = FALSE,
    ci_mood_logged          = FALSE
  )

# Factor levels to match training data
scenario_dat <- scenario_dat %>%
  mutate(
    ci_age_group            = factor(ci_age_group,            levels = c("18-24", "25-29", "30-34", "35-39", "40-45")),
    ui_ansMenarche_group    = factor(ui_ansMenarche_group,    levels = c("<= 11", "12-13", ">= 14", "Unknown")),
    ui_activitylevel        = factor(ui_activitylevel,        levels = c("Active", "Very active", "Not active")),
    ui_bmi_cat              = factor(ui_bmi_cat,              levels = levels(train$ui_bmi_cat)),
    ui_pcos_impute          = factor(ui_pcos_impute,          levels = levels(train$ui_pcos_impute)),
    ui_endometriosis_impute = factor(ui_endometriosis_impute, levels = levels(train$ui_endometriosis_impute)),
    ci_sickness_logged      = factor(ci_sickness_logged),
    ci_spotting_logged      = factor(ci_spotting_logged),
    ci_mood_logged          = factor(ci_mood_logged)
  )

profile_n <- eas %>%
  mutate(
    ui_pcos_impute       = as.character(ui_pcos_impute),
    ci_age_group         = as.character(ci_age_group),
    ui_ansMenarche_group = as.character(ui_ansMenarche_group),
    ui_activitylevel     = as.character(ui_activitylevel),
    ci_sickness_logged   = as.logical(as.character(ci_sickness_logged))
  ) %>%
  summarise(n = n(),
            .by = c(ci_age_group, ui_ansMenarche_group, ui_pcos_impute,
                    ui_activitylevel, ci_sickness_logged))

# Join n onto scenario_dat
scenario_dat <- scenario_dat %>%
  left_join(
    profile_n %>% mutate(across(c(ci_age_group, ui_ansMenarche_group,
                                   ui_pcos_impute, ui_activitylevel), as.character),
                          ci_sickness_logged = as.character(ci_sickness_logged)),
    by = c("ci_age_group"         = "ci_age_group",
           "ui_ansMenarche_group" = "ui_ansMenarche_group",
           "ui_pcos_impute"       = "ui_pcos_impute",
           "ui_activitylevel"     = "ui_activitylevel",
           "ci_sickness_logged"   = "ci_sickness_logged")
  ) %>%
  mutate(scenario_label = paste0(scenario_label, " (n = ", scales::comma(n), ")"))
```

```{r}
n_avail <- posterior::ndraws(fit)

pp_scen <- scenario_dat %>%
  tidybayes::add_predicted_draws(
    fit,
    re_formula = NA,                # population-level scenario contrasts
    ndraws = min(800, n_avail)
  ) %>%
  rename(y_pred = .prediction)
```

```{r}
#densities
ggplot(pp_scen, aes(x = y_pred, y = scenario_label)) +
  geom_density_ridges(scale = 1.1, rel_min_height = 0.01, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(21, 35), linetype = "dashed",
             color = "#E69F00", alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(x = "Predicted cycle length (days)", y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(axis.text.y = ggtext::element_markdown())
```
